opt.subtitle: Voice-over for YouTube subtitles – settings
opt.languageHelp: "Automatic" follows your system language. The voice-over language decides what the subtitles are translated into and which voices are offered; changing it re-synthesizes the current video.

opt.slowTranslator: slow; the voice-over will get the first sentences late
opt.translationHelp: LLM translators restore punctuation and sentence boundaries – that is what gives the voice-over natural intonation. Enable them and enter API keys in "Engines and voices" above.
opt.transferHelp: Export writes the extension settings, the server configuration (engines, translators, API keys) and voice samples into one file. On the other computer: install PolarnikTTS, start the server and import the file. The file contains API keys – treat it like a password.

about.what: Voice-over for YouTube – translates the subtitles and reads them in real time with the engine of your choice: local (GPU/CPU) or cloud, with voice cloning from your own sample.
about.author: Author:
about.credits: Designed and built entirely under the command of Claude Fable 5.1 (High) by Anthropic – from the analysis of the original, through architecture and the server and extension code, to testing – to MrTip's idea and requirements.
about.tech: MIT licence. Extension: Manifest V3, no libraries and no telemetry – nothing is sent anywhere except to the PolarnikTTS server and the providers you enable yourself. Server: Python + FastAPI, engine plugins (Microsoft Edge, Piper, Chatterbox, XTTS-v2, OpenAI, Gemini, ElevenLabs) and translators (OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama/Bielik, Claude, DeepL).
mg.intro: Install engines and voices, enable them and enter API keys here – no command line needed. Changes are saved to server/config.yaml and take effect immediately.
mg.translatorsHelp: An LLM translator restores punctuation and sentence boundaries, so the voice-over sounds more natural than with YouTube's automatic translation. After enabling one, select it in the "Translation" section above.
mg.keyInheritedPh: ✔ shared with the {src} translator – leave empty, enter one only if you want a different key
mg.keyOrTranslatorPh: paste a key or enter it for the {src} translator (it will be shared)
mg.copyKey: Copy the key to the clipboard
mg.listModels: Fetch the list of models from the provider
mg.pickModel: – pick a model from the list –
mg.testerHelp: Try a voice: pick one from the list, type a text and listen. "Set as default voice" stores the choice for this engine.
mg.samplesHelp: Voice samples for cloning (optional – the built-in voice works without one). Best: 5–15 s of clean speech, WAV or MP3.
mg.ollamaDownHelp: at {host} – install it from ollama.com/download and start it (tray icon).
mg.ollamaSuggested: Suggested models (type into the "Model" field, save, then "Pull model"):
mg.ollamaBielik11: 6.7 GB – best Polish quality, GPU with ≥ 8 GB VRAM
mg.ollamaBielik45: 5.1 GB – good compromise for Polish, 6 GB GPU
mg.ollamaGemma12: 8.1 GB – Google model, strong in most languages, GPU with ≥ 12 GB VRAM
mg.ollamaGemma4: 3.3 GB – Google model, good in most languages, fits a 6 GB GPU

engine.edge_tts.title: Microsoft Edge – neural voices
engine.edge_tts.desc: Very good neural voices from Microsoft in every supported language. No GPU needed, needs the internet. Unofficial API – it may stop working one day, so keep a local engine too. Default choice.
engine.piper.title: Piper – local, CPU
engine.piper.desc: Fast and fully offline, basic quality. Good as a fallback engine.
engine.chatterbox.title: Chatterbox Multilingual – local, GPU
engine.chatterbox.desc: Open-source model (MIT). Has a built-in default voice and can clone any voice from a 5–15 s sample (a sample in the target language also improves the accent). Needs an NVIDIA GPU. Installs into its own isolated environment (PyTorch with CUDA + model, ~4.5 GB).
engine.xtts.title: XTTS-v2 – local, GPU
engine.xtts.desc: Six built-in studio voices plus cloning from a sample. Non-commercial licence (personal use OK). Needs an NVIDIA GPU. Own isolated environment (~4.3 GB).
engine.openai_tts.title: OpenAI TTS – cloud, paid
engine.openai_tts.desc: OpenAI voices (gpt-4o-mini-tts), multilingual, read the text with a "voice-over narrator" instruction. Uses the key entered for the OpenAI translator unless you provide a separate one.
engine.gemini_tts.title: Google Gemini TTS – cloud
engine.gemini_tts.desc: 30 Gemini voices (Kore, Puck, Charon, …), multilingual. Uses the key entered for the Gemini translator unless you provide a separate one. Free tier in AI Studio, paid beyond it.
engine.elevenlabs.title: ElevenLabs – cloud, paid
engine.elevenlabs.desc: The most expressive voices. Needs an API key and an ElevenLabs account.
translator.ollama: Ollama – local LLM (e.g. Gemma, Bielik), no key
translator.deepl: DeepL – cloud, API key (free tier: 500k characters/month)
